verdict.rationale: Goodwin ships software tools through Founders Workbench, including Document Driver and the Capital and Liquidation Calculators, so a data-export story is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence documents exporting user data in open formats or account portability. The only related item says calculator results can carry over between Goodwin's own tools, which is internal hand-off, not export. The probes found no API surface (llms.txt and OpenAPI paths all returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
